summary_for_children: Az-Zalzalah says that whoever does even an atom's weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom's weight of bad will see it.
environment_concept: A morning garden where tiny specks of dust drift in shafts of sunlight and rows of very small seedlings grow. They show how small an atom's weight is (99:7-8): even the smallest good is seen. The earthquake of 99:1 and the Day are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Garden rows of seedlings, a gap in the trees where sunbeams fall.

areas.name: Seeds of Good
areas.description: Rows of tiny seedlings: even the smallest good is seen.

areas.name: Specks in the Sunlight
areas.description: Tiny specks of dust drifting in shafts of sunlight.

activities.name: Read the eight
activities.description: Put the eight ayahs of Az-Zalzalah in order.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Match each place to its ayah
activities.description: Match the seedlings and the sunbeams to the ayah each comes from.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Plant the seedlings
activities.description: Tap the three empty pots to plant a seedling in each.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: first version built: its own scene (seedling rows and dust motes in sunbeams), two playable games and one activity played in the scene

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
